senses.sense_definition: schade toebrengen of negatieve invloed hebben op iemand of iets

examples.text: Het koude weer zal de jonge planten in de tuin niet <w>deren</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The cold weather will not <w>harm</w> the young plants in the garden.

examples.text: De kritiek van zijn collega's leek hem totaal niet te <w>deren</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The criticism from his colleagues did not seem to <w>bother</w> him at all.

target_lang_definitions.en: To cause damage to or have a negative impact on someone or something.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to cause physical or emotional damage or injury
to cause pain or distress to someone
to cause someone to feel troubled or affected by something (often used in negative contexts)
